messages.use_the_replay_hotkey_or_save_a_clip: Use the replay hotkey or save a clip from the tray.
messages.use_the_screenshot_or_snip_hotkey_to_add: Use the screenshot or snip hotkey to add an image.
messages.title: Title
messages.this_permanently_removes_the_file_from_d: This permanently removes the file from disk.
messages.source_detection_help: Auto-detect uses Discord’s game catalog. If your game is missing, check the list, then use Add Game to register it in Nexory. You can also pick a running window directly.
messages.pick_the_game_window_to_remember_it_for: Pick the game window to remember it for future sessions. If it’s missing, open the game and refresh the list.
messages.open_the_game_first_then_refresh: Open the game first, then refresh.
messages.video_codec_help: All options save .mp4 files. H.264 is the safest choice for sharing. H.265 and AV1 may not preview in Discord or some browsers. Greyed-out formats are unsupported by the capture GPU. Changes apply when capture next starts.
messages.picks_a_hardware_encoder_for_your_captur: picks a hardware encoder for your capture GPU.
messages.for_intel_choose_manually_if_auto_picks_: for Intel. Choose manually if Auto picks the wrong encoder.
messages.records_everything_playing_on_your_defau: records everything playing on your default output.
messages.records_only_the_apps_you_choose_audio_s: records only the apps you choose. Audio source changes apply when capture next starts.
messages.avoids_disk_writes_during_capture_longer: avoids disk writes during capture. Longer buffers use more memory.
messages.writes_temporary_segments_to_keep_memory: writes temporary segments to keep memory use lower, especially near the 10-minute limit.
messages.the_buffer_is_how_much_recent_gameplay_n: The buffer holds recent gameplay. When locked, it follows the longest clip length, with a 15-second minimum. Unlock it to keep a longer history.
messages.is_a_compact_default_for_everyday_screen: is a compact default for everyday screenshots.
messages.preserves_pixels_losslessly_and_works_wi: preserves pixels losslessly and works with older apps.
messages.works_almost_everywhere_and_suits_photos: works almost everywhere and suits photos, with some loss of detail.
messages.play_trim_or_copy_your_saved_replays_and: Play, trim, or copy your saved replays and recordings here. Use search to find clips by title or game.
messages.find_and_copy_your_screenshots_and_snips: Find and copy your screenshots and snips here.
messages.choose_what_nexory_captures_how_much_rep: Choose what Nexory captures, how much replay it keeps, where it saves files, and which shortcuts it uses.
messages.for_help_with_a_setting_select: for help with a setting. Select
messages.guide_capture_preset: Choose a preset for video quality and audio. Open Advanced to change the capture source, add a game, or choose which apps to record.
messages.controls_how_much_footage_you_save: controls how much footage you save.
messages.controls_how_much_footage_nexory_keeps_a: controls how much footage Nexory keeps available.
messages.the_buffer_follows_clip_length_by_defaul: Add clip lengths to give them their own shortcuts. The buffer follows the longest length by default. In Advanced, you can choose Disk to keep memory use lower.
messages.choose_your_output_folder_screenshot_for: Choose your output folder, screenshot format, and whether to start Nexory with Windows.
messages.to_bring_your_library_with_you: to bring your library with you.
messages.click_a_shortcut_and_press_the_keys_you: Click a shortcut and press the keys you want to use within five seconds.
messages.nexory_stays_in_the_system_tray_when_you: Nexory stays in the system tray when you close the library. Pin it to the taskbar to reopen it in one click.
messages.right_click_the_nexory_icon_on_the_windo: Right-click the Nexory icon on the Windows taskbar and choose Pin to taskbar.
messages.drag_to_select_a_screen_region: Drag to select a screen region
messages.press_one_shortcut_key: Press one shortcut key with optional modifiers.
messages.snip_copy_failed: Could not copy. Drag to retry.
messages.guide_replay_shortcut: While playing, press {shortcut} to save the last few seconds.
messages.guide_screenshot_shortcuts: Press {screenshot} for a screenshot or {snip} to select an area. Release the mouse to save and copy the snip.
messages.guide_record_shortcut: Press {shortcut} to start or stop a manual recording.
messages.delete_many_warning: These files will be permanently removed from disk.
messages.saved_item_unavailable: The saved item is no longer in this library.
messages.capture_preset_help: Low impact uses 720p, 30 FPS, 5 Mbps and system audio. Balanced uses 1080p, 60 FPS and 12 Mbps. High quality uses 1440p, 60 FPS and 24 Mbps. Balanced and High quality also record the microphone.
